title: UX Intern
note: Experience design internship in McDonald's Global Technology program for rising college seniors; Visual/Graphic Design majors are named and a portfolio is required.

facts.duties: Work with product managers, engineers and researchers; user interviews, journey mapping and competitive analysis; wireframes, user flows and prototypes in Figma; present concepts to stakeholders.
facts.requirements: Rising senior pursuing a bachelor's in Visual/Graphic Design, HCI, design research or a similar program; familiar with Figma or Sketch; portfolio or work examples must be included.
facts.apply: Apply now button on the McDonald's job page; include portfolio.
